## `area:component/save-inspector-selection-pickers`

- **[Eagle](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401)** — A user-directed inspection of the installed Eagle 4 tag and folder selection
panels informed Pond's inspector pickers and side-by-side development gallery.
Pond adapts the shared search-focused panel concept, independent logical cursor,
inset folder-tree rows, a grouped tag grid, compact rows, keyboard legends, and
ellipsized labels. Pond intentionally omits Eagle's folder scope switcher, tag
sidebar, layout switcher, and pin button so assignment stays focused on one list
or grid. Pond implements its own Popover-based React PickerPanel primitive,
preserves explicit mixed selection and path search, uses Nucleo icons and Pond
design tokens, and retains its own mutation and accessibility behavior. For
direct comparison, the development-only gallery can route an ignored local
extraction of Eagle's original picker markup, JavaScript, CSS, and icons into
isolated iframe surfaces. Those extracted files are not committed, imported by Pond
product code, or included in Pond builds.
  - relationship: adapted; confidence: verified; recorded: 2026-09-27
  - Evidence: file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/detail/folder-menu/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/detail/folder-menu/styles.module.css`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/tags/components/menu/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/tags/components/menu/styles.module.css`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/tags/components/picker/picker.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/detail/pane/pane.test.tsx`; file: `packages/ui/src/picker-panel/index.tsx`; file: `packages/ui/src/picker-panel/styles.module.css`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/dev/picker-gallery/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/dev/picker-gallery/styles.module.css`; file: `apps/desktop/toolbar-gallery.vite.config.ts`

## `area:component/viewers`

- **[Eagle](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401)** — The [September 23 detail-view comparison](eagle-detail-view-comparison-2026-09-23.md)
informs Pond's shared, icon-first viewer chrome across image, video, audio,
document, text, font, model, archive, EPUB, live-photo, web, and generic file
detail views. Time-based media keeps utility actions above the canvas and
playback transport below it. A user-directed live comparison on September 27
additionally informed generated-preview zoom/comment/actual/fit actions; PDF
thumbnail, search, direct-page, zoom, fit, rotate, print, open, and export
actions; video and audio volume/sizing/transport actions; toggleable GIF frame
controls; and font Symbols and Information modes. Pond keeps each action group
continuous, with its sole viewer separator reserved for multi-slide navigation.
The implementation adapts grouping and placement discipline observed in
[Eagle (2026)](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401), while retaining Pond's own
components, accessible labels, keyboard behavior, and visual language; no Eagle
application code or assets ship in Pond.
Eagle is a behavioral reference for separating a persistent detail-view shell
from raster, temporal, and specialist content providers. Pond's implementation,
accessibility semantics, security boundaries, and source code are original.
  - relationship: adapted; confidence: verified; recorded: 2026-09-27
  - Evidence: file: `docs/references/eagle-detail-view-comparison-2026-09-23.md`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/file-viewer/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/video-player/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/image-inspector/controls/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/save-viewer/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/lib/media/viewer-capability.ts`

- **[Eagle](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401)** — A user-directed local gallery of 142 specimens covering 141 unique extensions
was opened in the installed Eagle 4 build to verify 17 practical detail-view
families, extension ownership, and observable failure states. Pond records that

raster, temporal, specialist, or explicit file-fallback surface rather than a
blank route. Eagle normally presents RAW files as cached or embedded rasters in
its shared image shell; full sensor development is a thumbnail-generation
fallback. Pond likewise unifies generated rasters in its image shell and defines
Actual Size from decoded derivative dimensions. Pond's implementation, labels,
components, loaders, and tests are independent; no Eagle code or assets are
copied or bundled.

## `area:feature/arrange-folder`

- **[dnd kit](./REFERENCES.md#dndkit-com)** — Official dnd kit guidance informed Pond's virtualized vertical Save sorter,
horizontal data-table column sorter, and folder-tree organization layer. The
implementations use detached overlays, dedicated activator handles, axis
modifiers, keyboard coordinates, cancellation, announcements, and reduced-
motion-aware landing animations. The folder tree deliberately keeps native
DataTransfer listeners for Save assignment while dnd kit owns only internal
folder organization. Pond retains TanStack Virtual ownership of Save row
mounting, its existing column-order state, and its folder-domain move planner.
  - relationship: adapted; confidence: verified; recorded: 2026-09-25

## `area:influence/companies`

- **[Building glass for the web](./REFERENCES.md#aave-com-design-building-glass-for-the-web)** — - **Lens Developer Dashboard** ([Lens, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#lens-developer-dashboard)) — the user-supplied Change Owner dialog reference informed tighter shared dialog spacing, smaller corner radii, restrained close controls, and a divided footer with content-sized actions. Visual inspiration only; no source code or assets copied. Usage terms are unknown. Account-specific details from the reference are not retained.
- **Linear Agent** ([Linear, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#linear-agent-docs)) — observed text shimmer and changing activity labels informed Pond's running-status presentation. Activity events ([Linear, n.d.-d](./REFERENCES.md#linear-agent-interaction)) informed the connection to actual tool execution. A user-supplied Agent personalization screenshot informed Intelligence Personalization: section title and description above a textarea card, without a storage caveat under the list.
- **Linear** ([Linear, n.d.-i](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app)) — filter chips, saved views,
  Insights ([Linear, n.d.-g](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-docs-insights)) and
  Dashboards ([Linear, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-docs-dashboards)) informed the analytics page;
  filtering docs ([Linear, n.d.-e](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-docs-filters)) informed the query model.
  User-supplied workspace-menu and settings screenshots informed the nested Library switcher and the placement of Library customization.
  The Linear Method ([Linear, n.d.-l](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-method)),
  changelog ([Linear, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-changelog)),
  Now ([Linear, n.d.-k](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-now)),
  labels ([Linear, n.d.-h](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-docs-labels)),
  dashboards best practices ([Linear, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-now-dashboards-best-practices)), and
  how we built triage intelligence ([Linear, n.d.-f](./REFERENCES.md#linear-app-now-how-we-built-triage-intelligence))
  informed product writing and analytics.
- **Family** ([Family, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#family-co)) and
  **ConnectKit** ([Family, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#family-co-docs-connectkit-theme-builder)) — the dock's
  morphing pill/tray interaction and modal page transitions. Family's iOS app
  on Mobbin ([Mobbin, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-com-apps-family-ios-91274a89-9f29-40f9-9b83-c7dae12d40b6-46088ce2-9ad5-4019-9ccc-6f8a050e9638-screens))
  was a primary dock/flow reference. Family Values ([Taylor, 2024](./REFERENCES.md#benji-org-family-values))
  is the essay behind that interaction model.
- **Vercel** ([Vercel, n.d.-f](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-com)) — Geist ([Vercel, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-com-geist-colors)),
  empty states ([Vercel, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-com-geist-empty-state)),
  composable input prefixes and suffixes ([Vercel, n.d.-o](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-com-geist-input)),
  writing guidelines ([Vercel, n.d.-h](./REFERENCES.md#github-com-vercel-labs-writing-guidelines)), and
  web interface guidelines ([Vercel, n.d.-g](./REFERENCES.md#github-com-vercel-labs-web-interface-guidelines)).
- **Apple** ([Apple, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#developer-apple-com-design-human-interface-guidelines)) —
  HIG, Icon Composer ([Apple, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#developer-apple-com-icon-composer)), and liquid-glass
  window chrome.
- **Eagle** ([Eagle, n.d.-ae](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-cool)) — local-first media library.
  Tags ([Eagle, n.d.-bi](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-tags)),
  organizing tags ([Eagle, n.d.-ax](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-organizing-tags)),
  detail mode ([Eagle, n.d.-y](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-cool-support-article-detail-mode)), and
  desktop search ([Eagle, n.d.-x](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-cool-support-desktop-search)).
  Shortcut customization ([Eagle, n.d.-w](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-cool-support-article-customize-shortcuts))
  and the macOS app-data location
  ([Eagle, n.d.-o](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-cannot-find-application-support))
  informed the local Eagle shortcut importer.
- **PandaDoc** ([Mobbin, n.d.-k](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-pandadoc-bulk-import-progress)) —
  its completed-item count and per-item processing state informed the Eagle import progress toast.
- **Cosmos** ([Cosmos, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so)) and **Are.na** ([Are.na, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#are-na)) —
  capture sources and grid/collection layout. Cosmos collections used as layout
  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),
  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and
  Amelie Schltr ([Schltr, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-amelieschltr)).
- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.
- **Cursor MCP** ([Cursor, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#cursor-mcp)) and connecting local MCP servers ([Model Context Protocol, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#modelcontextprotocol-connect-local)) informed Intelligence MCP: the live stdio command and no hosted URL. **Resurf** ([Resurf, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#resurf-so)) informed the Access switches, always-visible host list, setup popover, More Agents, and Advanced command. A later menu-bar screenshot informed replacing tray recents with create and import actions, Search, Settings, and a version footer. Host CLI copy follows Claude Code MCP ([Anthropic, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-claude-code-mcp)), Codex MCP ([OpenAI, n.d.-d](./REFERENCES.md#openai-codex-mcp)), and Gemini CLI MCP ([Google, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#google-gemini-cli-mcp)).
- **Seline** ([Seline, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#seline-com)) and **Visitors** ([Visitors, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#visitors-now)) —
  quiet, minimal analytics dashboards.
- **Campsite** ([Campsite, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#github-com-campsite-campsite)) — settings atoms and
  composed page structure.
- **Immich** ([Immich, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#immich-app)) and **PhotoPrism** ([PhotoPrism, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#photoprism-app)) —

- **ArchiveBox** ([ArchiveBox, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#github-com-archivebox-archivebox)) — local-first web archive

Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

- **Cosmos** ([Cosmos, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so)) and **Are.na** ([Are.na, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#are-na)) —
  capture sources and grid/collection layout. Cosmos collections used as layout
  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),
  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and

- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.

- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.

  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),

  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.

  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),
  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and
  Amelie Schltr ([Schltr, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-amelieschltr)).
- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.
- **Cursor MCP** ([Cursor, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#cursor-mcp)) and connecting local MCP servers ([Model Context Protocol, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#modelcontextprotocol-connect-local)) informed Intelligence MCP: the live stdio command and no hosted URL. **Resurf** ([Resurf, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#resurf-so)) informed the Access switches, always-visible host list, setup popover, More Agents, and Advanced command. A later menu-bar screenshot informed replacing tray recents with create and import actions, Search, Settings, and a version footer. Host CLI copy follows Claude Code MCP ([Anthropic, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-claude-code-mcp)), Codex MCP ([OpenAI, n.d.-d](./REFERENCES.md#openai-codex-mcp)), and Gemini CLI MCP ([Google, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#google-gemini-cli-mcp)).

  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),
  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and

- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.

  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).

  capture sources and grid/collection layout. Cosmos collections used as layout
  references include Linus Rogge ([Rogge, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-linusrogge)),
  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and

- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.

  Maximilian Stallboerger ([Stallboerger, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-stallboerger)), and
  Amelie Schltr ([Schltr, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-so-amelieschltr)).
- **Raycast** ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) — settings layout
  (manual ([Raycast, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#manual-raycast-com-settings))).
  The installed AI settings ([Raycast, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#raycast-com)) informed Intelligence's Providers and Personalization split, defaults-first ordering, and grouped profile fields. The user-supplied Raycast model table informed earlier provider detail pages and model visibility controls. A later user-supplied Cursor model-picker screenshot informed compact row density, short Input/Output/Context columns, and `200k`-style tokens; speed and intelligence meters were not copied because Pond has no verified ratings. The Vercel AI Gateway models list ([Vercel, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models-list)) informed moving that catalog onto one Intelligence Models page with Model, Provider, Input, Output, Context, and Show columns. Type, Tags, Latency, ZDR, and Free Tier were not copied. Compact `$n/M` prices, `200K` context, and header/cell tooltips follow that table’s density and hover pattern: headers define the column, cells expand the abbreviation. Pond wording does not use Gateway routing or credit copy. Context metadata and pagination follow [Anthropic (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-models-api) and [Google (n.d.)](./REFERENCES.md#google-models-api).
- **Cursor** ([Mobbin, n.d.-j](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-cursor-model-selector)) — the compact Agent model menu and side-submenu structure. Pond keeps unsupported controls visible but unavailable and retains its own provider metadata and settings navigation.
- **Cursor MCP** ([Cursor, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#cursor-mcp)) and connecting local MCP servers ([Model Context Protocol, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#modelcontextprotocol-connect-local)) informed Intelligence MCP: the live stdio command and no hosted URL. **Resurf** ([Resurf, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#resurf-so)) informed the Access switches, always-visible host list, setup popover, More Agents, and Advanced command. A later menu-bar screenshot informed replacing tray recents with create and import actions, Search, Settings, and a version footer. Host CLI copy follows Claude Code MCP ([Anthropic, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-claude-code-mcp)), Codex MCP ([OpenAI, n.d.-d](./REFERENCES.md#openai-codex-mcp)), and Gemini CLI MCP ([Google, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#google-gemini-cli-mcp)).
- **Seline** ([Seline, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#seline-com)) and **Visitors** ([Visitors, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#visitors-now)) —

intake, routing, and Library organization after each tool saves its output.

selected 20 preview-inspected Cosmos elements from the
[*Desktop inspector panel UI* search](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-desktop-inspector-panel-ui).
The strongest direction combines a persistent narrow inspector, one aligned
Properties definition list, restrained section dividers, contextual menus for
secondary organization actions, and separate Source and Activity groups. Visible
Cosmos uploader labels do not establish original authorship; original-source links
and reuse terms were unavailable. This is layout inspiration only. No assets or
code were copied.

- **[Browser Extension](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-browser-extension)** — The [September 22 screenshot research](eagle-screenshots-2026-09-22.md) uses
[Eagle (n.d.-p)](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-capturing-screenshots)
and the installed [Eagle (2026)](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401) preferences
to inform direct area, window, and full-screen capture with optional organization
afterward. Screenshot tagging
([Eagle, n.d.-bm](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-disable-screenshot-tags)), notifications
([Eagle, n.d.-bn](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-disable-screenshot-notification)), and
Retina capture ([Eagle, n.d.-bo](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-retina-screenshots))
inform the persistent Screenshots settings page. The shortcut reference
([Eagle, n.d.-bp](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-keyboard-shortcuts)) conflicts with the
capture guide and installed bindings; the note preserves that uncertainty.
Browser capture ([Eagle, n.d.-bl](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-browser-extension))
is recorded separately. At the user's request, screenshot-related source files
were extracted into the ignored `apps/desktop/.tmp/eagle-screenshots/` directory,
with archive and per-file hashes. The readable Mac capture wrapper delegates
area/window selection to the operating system. This is behavioral inspiration
for Pond’s independently implemented native capture and save dialog; no Eagle code or assets were added to the shipped app,
and redistribution terms remain unestablished.

- **[Capturing screenshots](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-capturing-screenshots)** — The [September 22 screenshot research](eagle-screenshots-2026-09-22.md) uses
[Eagle (n.d.-p)](./REFERENCES.md#en-eagle-cool-support-article-capturing-screenshots)
and the installed [Eagle (2026)](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401) preferences
to inform direct area, window, and full-screen capture with optional organization
afterward. Screenshot tagging
([Eagle, n.d.-bm](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-disable-screenshot-tags)), notifications
([Eagle, n.d.-bn](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-disable-screenshot-notification)), and
Retina capture ([Eagle, n.d.-bo](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-retina-screenshots))
inform the persistent Screenshots settings page. The shortcut reference
([Eagle, n.d.-bp](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-keyboard-shortcuts)) conflicts with the
capture guide and installed bindings; the note preserves that uncertainty.
Browser capture ([Eagle, n.d.-bl](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-browser-extension))
is recorded separately. At the user's request, screenshot-related source files
were extracted into the ignored `apps/desktop/.tmp/eagle-screenshots/` directory,
with archive and per-file hashes. The readable Mac capture wrapper delegates
area/window selection to the operating system. This is behavioral inspiration
for Pond’s independently implemented native capture and save dialog; no Eagle code or assets were added to the shipped app,
and redistribution terms remain unestablished.

## `area:influence/processing-status-research`

- **[Sync status cards](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-sync-status-cards)** — Searching Cosmos directly surfaced compact sync-status cards
([*Sync status cards*, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#cosmos-sync-status-cards)) with
distinct in-progress, completed, and delayed states. A status icon and title sit
above secondary timing text; separate rows align Events Found and Sources Checked
with their counts. This is the closest reference for the proposed Pond processing
overview: one status header with readable activity counts below. Original creator,
publication date, and reuse terms are unknown; no code or assets were copied.
  - relationship: copied; confidence: unknown; recorded: 2026-09-24
  - Evidence: file: `docs/provenance/migration/legacy-influences.md`
  - Note: Migrated from Pond's previous hand-maintained reference record; relationship details should be tightened when the affected artifact next changes.
- **[Basecamp export processing](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-basecamp-export-processing)** — The processing-status review used Basecamp's export status
([Mobbin, n.d.-m](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-basecamp-export-processing)), Mercor's
Uploaded / Processing / Results stages
([Mobbin, n.d.-n](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-mercor-connection-processing)), and
Zillow's document-generation checklist
([Mobbin, n.d.-o](./REFERENCES.md#mobbin-zillow-document-processing)).
The proposed direction for Pond is a compact status headline, a breakdown of active
processing types, and a separate explanation of when processing pauses. Mercor's
sequential stages are a hierarchy reference; Pond's enrichments can run independently.
Basecamp's background-completion promise does not apply to Pond's hidden-window pause.
These are visual research references, with original designs by Basecamp, Mercor,

## `area:influence/repository-engineering`

- **[utilityProcess](./REFERENCES.md#electronjs-org-docs-latest-api-utility-process)** — Queue V2 uses short immediate write transactions and WAL-backed snapshot
isolation based on SQLite's transaction and isolation documentation
([SQLite, n.d.-a](./REFERENCES.md#sqlite-isolation);
[SQLite, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#sqlite-transaction)). Electron's
`utilityProcess` lifecycle and message-port contract informed the supervised
worker boundary
([Electron, n.d.-e](./REFERENCES.md#electronjs-org-docs-latest-api-utility-process)).
SQLite remains the only durable queue store. Utility workers never settle task
rows.

## `area:inventory/on-device-ai-models`

- **[Hugging Face](./REFERENCES.md#huggingface-co)** — Inference runs locally via Transformers.js (`@huggingface/transformers`, ONNX
backend). Curated model IDs and revisions are defined in
`apps/desktop/src/shared/on-device-models.ts`. Natural-language search compiles
with the Agent provider you configured in Settings. Weights for on-device

- **[Get an API key](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-get-api-key)** — Enrichments run on-device. Agent uses a key you paste for an official AI SDK chat provider, stored in `safeStorage`, or a local host you run such as Ollama or LM Studio. Pond does not host a model gateway. Official key pages for Anthropic ([Anthropic, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#anthropic-get-api-key)), Gemini ([Google, n.d.-b](./REFERENCES.md#google-gemini-api-keys)), and OpenAI ([OpenAI, n.d.-c](./REFERENCES.md#openai-api-keys)) document those provider keys. Cloud model metadata is fetched without credentials from the public Vercel AI Gateway catalog (`GET https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models`; [Vercel, n.d.-i](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-rest-api)). Gateway models-and-providers documentation ([Vercel, 2026](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models)) describes that catalog. The catalog supplies names and metadata, while inference continues directly through the configured provider. Pond also speaks MCP over stdio so Cursor and Claude can search this library. Provider logo tiles in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/assets/logos/providers` are vendored from `@lobehub/icons-static-avatar` 1.14.0 ([LobeHub, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#github-com-lobehub-lobe-icons)).
  - relationship: bundled; confidence: unknown; recorded: 2026-09-24
  - Evidence: file: `docs/provenance/migration/legacy-inventory.md`
  - Note: Migrated from Pond's previous hand-maintained reference record; relationship details should be tightened when the affected artifact next changes.

`apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/assets/logos/reverse-search` identify the
services that receive a search. The Google Lens logo is copied from
[Google (2023)](./REFERENCES.md#google-lens-icon). Bing, SauceNAO, TinEye,
and Yandex marks are PNG conversions of each service's official favicon
([Bing, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#bing-favicon);
[SauceNAO, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#saucenao-favicon);
[TinEye, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#tineye-favicon);
[Yandex, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#yandex-favicon)). Google Lens identifies its
logo as public-domain geometry subject to trademark restrictions. Usage terms
for the four official favicons are not recorded; their trademarks remain with
their owners. Baidu and Sogou open their official image-search surfaces
([Baidu, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#graph-baidu-com-pcpage-index);
[Sogou, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#pic-sogou-com-ris)) without vendored marks.

- **[Google Lens icon](./REFERENCES.md#google-lens-icon)** — Reverse-image search marks in
`apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/assets/logos/reverse-search` identify the
services that receive a search. The Google Lens logo is copied from
[Google (2023)](./REFERENCES.md#google-lens-icon). Bing, SauceNAO, TinEye,
and Yandex marks are PNG conversions of each service's official favicon
([Bing, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#bing-favicon);
[SauceNAO, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#saucenao-favicon);
[TinEye, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#tineye-favicon);
[Yandex, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#yandex-favicon)). Google Lens identifies its
logo as public-domain geometry subject to trademark restrictions. Usage terms
for the four official favicons are not recorded; their trademarks remain with
their owners. Baidu and Sogou open their official image-search surfaces
([Baidu, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#graph-baidu-com-pcpage-index);
[Sogou, n.d.](./REFERENCES.md#pic-sogou-com-ris)) without vendored marks.

Agent uses a key you paste for an official AI SDK chat provider, stored in `safeStorage`, or a local host you run such as Ollama or LM Studio. Pond does not host a model gateway. Cloud model metadata is fetched without credentials from the public Vercel AI Gateway catalog (`GET https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models`; [Vercel, n.d.-i](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-rest-api)). Gateway models-and-providers documentation ([Vercel, 2026](./REFERENCES.md#vercel-gateway-models)) describes that catalog. The catalog supplies names and metadata, while inference continues directly through the configured provider. Pond also speaks MCP over stdio so Cursor and Claude can search this library. ## `area:test/eagle-detail-view-corpus`

- **[Eagle](./REFERENCES.md#eagle-4-20260401)** — A user-directed local gallery of 142 specimens covering 141 unique extensions
was opened in the installed Eagle 4 build to verify 17 practical detail-view
families, extension ownership, and observable failure states. Pond records that
empirical matrix separately from Eagle's official import manifest, routes source
files through its text viewer, and uses its existing lazy Three.js viewer for AMF,
VTK, USDC, and USDZ while preserving generated-preview and original-file actions
for unsupported or failed formats. Every observed extension terminates in a
raster, temporal, specialist, or explicit file-fallback surface rather than a
blank route. Eagle normally presents RAW files as cached or embedded rasters in
its shared image shell; full sensor development is a thumbnail-generation
fallback. Pond likewise unifies generated rasters in its image shell and defines
Actual Size from decoded derivative dimensions. Pond's implementation, labels,
components, loaders, and tests are independent; no Eagle code or assets are
copied or bundled.
  - relationship: verified; confidence: verified; recorded: 2026-09-27
  - Evidence: file: `apps/desktop/src/shared/eagle-detail-view-formats.ts`; file: `apps/desktop/src/shared/eagle-detail-view-formats.test.ts`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/lib/media/eagle-gallery-viewers.test.ts`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/model-viewer/load-model.ts`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/save-viewer/index.tsx`; file: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/saves/components/viewers/viewer-fallback/index.tsx`; file: `docs/references/eagle-detail-view-comparison-2026-09-23.md`
  - Note: The local corpus included valid common files and synthetic or minimal proprietary specimens; the relationship verifies observed UI routing, not universal decoding support.
